Name: Improved Photos for Haley's 8 Heart Event
Author: sedoneybaloney
Description:
Have you ever noticed how strange the polaroid photos in Haley's eight heart event look?
That's because they haven't been updated in an extremely long time!

In the current version of Stardew Valley, the polaroids use beta sprites for Haley, the cows, and the surrounding environment. This mod fixes that!
With [u]Improved Photos for Haley's Eight Heart Event[/u][i],[/i] the photos have been updated to resemble Stardew Valley in its current state.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the polaroid photos in Haley's eight heart event with modern sprites
[*]Photos now depict Haley in her seasonal attire if the event is triggered in winter
[*]Includes original sprites to replace the outdated, photo-only sprites not found in Haley's sprite sheet
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Ensure [u]Content Patcher[/u] is installed
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract file into the Stardew Valley mods folder
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Should only interfere with mods that alter the polaroid photos in Haley's eight heart event
[*]Will cause visual inconsistencies if used alongside mods that drastically alter Haley's clothing or general appearance
[*]Has only been tested with version 1.6 (if you use this mod with an earlier version of the game, please let me know how it goes)
[/list]
This is the first mod I've ever uploaded, so thank you in advance to anyone who downloads! Please let me know if you encounter any bugs.
Coming soon: Mod that polishes [i]all [/i]of Haley's portraits and overworld sprites. Stay tuned!
